g.text: EoS F280049C Board, rev A, two BoosterPack-compatible (40-pin) sites. Designed by Kartikeydheer Srivastava.

g.desc: EoS F280049C Board, rev A, two BoosterPack-compatible (40-pin) sites. Designed by Kartikeydheer Srivastava.

g.text: Copyright (c) 2026 Kartikeydheer Srivastava. All rights reserved; see LICENSE.txt.

g.desc: Copyright (c) 2026 Kartikeydheer Srivastava. All rights reserved; see LICENSE.txt.

g.text: Values from TI SPRS945H (TMS320F28004x) and SPRACZ9A; TI SPRU655I; Silicon Labs CP2102N Rev. 1.5;

g.desc: Values from TI SPRS945H (TMS320F28004x) and SPRACZ9A; TI SPRU655I; Silicon Labs CP2102N Rev. 1.5;

g.text: Diodes DS37274; Littelfuse SP05xxBA and 1206L; Nexperia PMEG6010CEH; SiTime SiT8008B; Kingbright; TI SLVA689A.

g.desc: Diodes DS37274; Littelfuse SP05xxBA and 1206L; Nexperia PMEG6010CEH; SiTime SiT8008B; Kingbright; TI SLVA689A.

g.text: Firmware: X1 single-ended (XTALCR.SE = 1); clear GPAAMSEL for GPIO22; LIN-A in SCI mode for site A's UART.

g.desc: Firmware: X1 single-ended (XTALCR.SE = 1); clear GPAAMSEL for GPIO22; LIN-A in SCI mode for site A's UART.

g.text: JP1: none = flash boot, 1-2 = SCI boot (USB bridge), 3-4 = CAN, both = parallel.

g.desc: JP1: none = flash boot, 1-2 = SCI boot (USB bridge), 3-4 = CAN, both = parallel.

g.text: Budget: BoosterPacks 200 mA in all from 3.3 V and 5 V pins, no more than 125 mA from 3.3 V.

g.desc: Budget: BoosterPacks 200 mA in all from 3.3 V and 5 V pins, no more than 125 mA from 3.3 V.

g.text: J1.1 and J5.41 (3.3 V) are outputs only; the 5 V pins carry USB VBUS less a fuse and a Schottky.

g.desc: J1.1 and J5.41 (3.3 V) are outputs only; the 5 V pins carry USB VBUS less a fuse and a Schottky.

g.text: BoosterPack sites A and B (40-pin standard each)

g.desc: BoosterPack sites A and B (40-pin standard each)

g.text: CP2102N USB-UART on SCIA (on 3.3 V, VBUS sense + bleed)

g.desc: CP2102N USB-UART on SCIA (on 3.3 V, VBUS sense + bleed)
